reviews.title: Great app, great support, completely worth it!
reviews.text: I’ve used other adult content blocking apps, and this one excels my expectations. What I really like about this app is that web browsers can be blocked and that really helped me in my journey to recovery. It also includes many helpful resources that help you understand why the addiction is happening and what you can do to escape it. Also Sam has been really helpful when I encountered some bugs in the app. If you’re serious about recovery I recommend you give Escape a try. It’s well worth its subscription price and it has many tools that help you in your recovery journey.

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: I am very fortunate to have found Escape. No pressure just some help that’s sincere and consistent. There’s no one size fits all but this app will go along way in helping you to escape the darkness and enter the light.
